Kara: Quick thread 0 min0 - pen test Wed. Need owners for ephemeral RBAC, KMS for evidence, audit exports, and retest booking. Who can take what?
Jamal: I can own RBAC + automation. Plan: create per-assessor role `pt/assessor/<id>/1912349991` with 4h session and `pt-id` tag. We'll provision via terraform module so revoke is automated.
Renee: I'll handle KMS keys. Create alias `alias/pt-evidence-1912349991` in each account. Grants limited to role principal and ingestion lambda. Revoke grant immediately post-window.
Kara: Evidence uploads - presigned PUTs, 4h expiry, unique prefix per assessor. Require `.sha256` sidecar. Also collect CloudTrail assume-role events into `s3://rw-pt-evidence/1912349991/audit/`.
Jamal: sample assume-role policy we'll hand out after dry-run:
`{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Resource":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-1912349991"}]}`
Renee: KMS grant example (ops):
`aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-evidence-1912349991 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-1912349991 --operations Encrypt Decrypt --name pt-grant-1912349991`
Kara: Retest slots: Thu 13:00-15:00; please add two 30m slots and link ticket. Dry-run Tue 07:30.
ops-bot: Jira RW-PT-2026-1912349991 created and assigned to Jamal, Renee.
Jamal: action items TL;DR: Jamal (role + presign automation), Renee (KMS key + revoke), Kara (runbook + calendar). I'll open PR with terraform + revoke job and ping here.
Renee: will post key ARN and grant-id after create.
Kara: thanks everyone 10min sync Mon EOD to confirm. :thumbsup:
